RULE_TEXT: Total income must equal the sum of all income line items
AGI must equal Total Income minus above-the-line deductions
Taxable income must equal AGI minus deductions and QBI
Total tax must equal sum of all tax liability components
Total payments must equal sum of withholding and refundable credits
Overpayment must equal total payments minus total tax
Amount owed must equal total tax minus total payments when tax exceeds payments
Refund must equal overpayment minus amount applied to next year
Standard or itemized deduction must match claimed type
Child tax credit cannot exceed 2000 per qualifying child
Tax year in return must be 2024
Filing status code must be a valid value (1=Single 2=MFJ 3=MFS 4=HOH 5=QSS)
Primary taxpayer SSN must be present and valid format
Spouse SSN required for MFJ or MFS filing status
Primary taxpayer date of birth must be present
Return must have a valid signature date not in the future
Paid preparer must provide PTIN or SSN if PreparedByOtherThanTaxpayer is true
Electronic filer identification number must be 6 digits
IP PIN must match IRS records if taxpayer has been assigned one
Primary SSN must not have been used on a previously accepted return for this tax year
Form 8960 required when net investment income tax is greater than zero
Form 6251 required when alternative minimum tax is greater than zero
Schedule SE required when self-employment tax is present
Schedule A required when taxpayer itemizes deductions
Schedule B required when taxable interest or ordinary dividends exceed 1500
RULE_EXPRESSION: If [TaxableInterestAmt] > 1500 OR [OrdinaryDividendsAmt] > 1500 Then [IRS1040ScheduleB] must be attached

RULE_TEXT: Schedule C required when self-employment income is present
Schedule D required when capital gains or losses are reported
Schedule E required when supplemental income or loss is present
Form 1116 required when foreign tax credit is claimed
Form 8812 required when additional child tax credit is claimed
Wages reported on 1040 must reconcile with W-2 wages attached
Federal withholding on 1040 must reconcile with W-2 withholding
Taxable interest should reconcile with 1099-INT amounts attached
RULE_EXPRESSION: If [IRS1099INT] is attached Then ABS([TaxableInterestAmt] - SUM([IRS1099INT].InterestIncomeAmt)) <= 1

RULE_TEXT: Ordinary dividends should reconcile with 1099-DIV amounts attached
RULE_EXPRESSION: If [IRS1099DIV] is attached Then ABS([OrdinaryDividendsAmt] - SUM([IRS1099DIV].OrdinaryDividendsAmt)) <= 1

RULE_TEXT: Mortgage interest deduction should reconcile with 1098 amounts
AGI increase of more than 25 percent from prior year warrants review
Charitable contributions exceeding 50 percent of AGI require Form 8283
Medical expense deduction limited to expenses exceeding 7.5 percent of AGI
Large refund of more than 10000 warrants secondary review
EIC amount must not exceed maximum for filing status and child count
SALT deduction limited to 10000 for MFJ Single and HOH filers
SALT deduction limited to 5000 for MFS filers
Traditional IRA deduction phase-out applies for workplace plan participants (Single filers)
RULE_EXPRESSION: If [WorkplacePlanParticipantInd] = true AND [FilingStatusCd] = 1 AND [AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt] > 77000 Then [IRADeductionAmt] <= MAX(0, 7000 - ([AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt] - 77000) / 10000 * 7000)

RULE_TEXT: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out applies for workplace plan participants (MFJ filers)
RULE_EXPRESSION: If [WorkplacePlanParticipantInd] = true AND [FilingStatusCd] = 2 AND [AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt] > 123000 Then [IRADeductionAmt] <= MAX(0, 7000 - ([AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt] - 123000) / 10000 * 7000)

RULE_TEXT: Child tax credit phases out at 200000 AGI for MFJ filers (400000 in 2024)
Child tax credit phases out at 200000 AGI for non-MFJ filers
NIIT of 3.8 percent applies to lesser of NII or excess MAGI over threshold (MFJ 250000)
NIIT of 3.8 percent applies for Single filers over 200000 MAGI
Additional Medicare Tax of 0.9 percent on wages over 250000 for MFJ filers
Additional Medicare Tax of 0.9 percent on wages over 200000 for Single filers
Standard deduction for Single filers in 2024 is 14600
Standard deduction for MFJ filers in 2024 is 29200
Standard deduction for HOH filers in 2024 is 21900
Standard deduction for MFS filers in 2024 is 14600
401k employee contribution cannot exceed annual limit of 23000 for taxpayers under age 50
401k employee contribution cannot exceed annual limit of 30500 for taxpayers age 50 or older (catch-up included)
HSA contribution limit for self-only HDHP coverage is 4150 in 2024
HSA contribution limit for family HDHP coverage is 8300 in 2024
Student loan interest deduction phases out for Single filers at MAGI over 75000
Student loan interest deduction phases out for MFJ filers at MAGI over 155000
